name: OLEFormat
remarks: If the Shape object doesn't represent a linked or embedded object, the OLEFormat property of the Shape object fails.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: Returns the OLE Automation object associated with this OLE object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: progID
properties.description: Returns the programmatic identifiers for the object. Read-only String.

methods.name: Verb
methods.description: Sends a verb to the server of the specified OLE object.

parameters.name: Verb
parameters.description: The verb that the server of the OLE object should act on. If this argument is omitted, the default verb is sent. The available verbs are determined by the object's source application. Typical verbs for an OLE object are Open and Primary (represented by the XlOLEVerb constants xlOpen and xlPrimary).
